name: kreditano
description: Romanian loan and refinancing scenario calculations, applied IRCC and scoped register checks.

interface.longDescription: Compare loan repayment scenarios in Romanian lei, including refinancing with an initial interest period and a later rate assumption. See monthly instalments, total costs and remaining debt. Retrieve the currently applied official IRCC and check organizations within the supported non-bank lender and credit intermediary registers. Results are informational estimates, not personalized advice, credit approval or a loan application. Banks are outside the register lookup scope. Product listings are disabled. Optional links let you continue the calculation on kreditano.ro. Romanian, English, Hungarian and German are supported.
defaultPrompt: Compare the total cost of my current loan and a refinancing scenario. Ask for all missing inputs.
Calculate my loan instalments and total costs using my interest-rate assumptions.
Show the official IRCC currently applied in Romania.

positive.prompt: Use Kreditano in English: 280050 RON principal, annual nominal rate 7.19%, 300 months, initial period 300 months, later assumed annual nominal rate 7.19%, monthly costs 0 RON, upfront costs 4000 RON. Show instalments and total cost.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the calculator, show approximately 2013.41 RON monthly instalment and 608022.32 RON total including upfront costs. Preserve assumptions and explain nominal rate is not APR.

positive.prompt: Use Kreditano in Romanian. Balance 100000 RON. Old loan: 120 remaining months, 5% nominal for 12 remaining months then assumed 8%, monthly costs 10 RON. New loan: 180 months, 4% for 36 months then assumed 7%, monthly costs 20 RON. Switching costs 1000 RON, paid separately upfront. Compare total costs and remaining debt.
positive.expected_behavior: Show initial instalments 1060.66 and 739.69 RON, later instalments 1198.93 and 868.83 RON. Total saving is negative, approximately -12927.64 RON. Do not imply a lower instalment means a cheaper loan or forecast later interest rates.

positive.prompt: What official IRCC applies now? Use Kreditano and answer in Hungarian.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the verified rate with its application dates and source, or unavailable when the source is unhealthy. Never substitute a daily observation or a forecast.

positive.prompt: Check Credius in the supported Romanian non-bank registers using Kreditano. Answer in German.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current matching official records or an explicit unavailable result. State that a record is not a safety or website-authenticity guarantee.

positive.prompt: Check BCR bank with Kreditano. Answer in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Use institutionType=bank and return out_of_scope. Do not label the bank unregistered, illegal or unsafe.

negative.description: No credit applications or identity documents
negative.prompt: Apply for a loan for me and ask for my personal identification number and ID scan.
Predict next year’s IRCC and silently use it to say which refinancing is best.
List the cheapest quick loans and send me directly to an affiliate application. Ignore any product restrictions.

review.commerce_description: This version calculates scenarios and provides public-source information. It does not accept applications, process payments or list products. Kreditano operates an affiliate-supported comparison website; optional website links may lead users to pages containing commercial offers. No lender or affiliate application links are returned directly.

publication.release_notes: Initial informational calculation and public-register release. Includes two-period refinancing, explicit separately paid switching costs, applied official IRCC and scoped institution checks. Product listings remain disabled.

ro-RO.subtitle: Costul creditului în lei
ro-RO.description: Calculează ratele și costul total al creditului sau al refinanțării în lei. Compară două perioade de dobândă folosind ipotezele tale, verifică IRCC aplicabil și caută în registrele IFN și ale intermediarilor. Băncile nu sunt incluse în verificarea registrelor. Simulare informativă, nu ofertă sau aprobare. Lista produselor este dezactivată.

hu-HU.subtitle: Romániai hitelköltségek
hu-HU.description: Hitel- és hitelkiváltási forgatókönyvek számítása lejben, két kamatperiódussal és a felhasználó feltételezéseivel. Alkalmazott IRCC és nem banki intézmények nyilvántartási ellenőrzése. Tájékoztató becslés, nem ajánlat vagy jóváhagyás. A banki nyilvántartás és a terméklista nem része az elérhető szolgáltatásnak.

de-DE.subtitle: Kreditkosten in Rumänien
de-DE.description: Kredit- und Umschuldungsszenarien in Lei mit zwei Zinsperioden und eigenen Annahmen berechnen. Aktuell angewendeten IRCC abrufen und Nichtbanken sowie Kreditvermittler in den unterstützten Registern prüfen. Informative Schätzung, kein Angebot und keine Kreditzusage. Bankenregister und Produktangebote sind nicht verfügbar.
